items.name: pnl-attribution-report
items.title: P&L attribution report
items.description: Display of a native single-instrument P&L attribution: totals, factor buckets, a signed factor chart, the Rust waterfall steps, the residual and notes.
items.docs: Display-only view of a PnlAttribution as returned (by attribution.attributePnl / attributePnlMany, or inside scenarios.computeHorizonReturn): total, mark-to-market and endpoint values, every factor bucket as exact money with a signed bar chart of the returned amounts, the waterfall drawn only from Rust's waterfall_steps (pv_before to pv_after per step; nothing when the method returns none), the residual with the returned residual_pct and tolerances, notes, the policy stamp and the JSON. A required buckets prop takes Rust's pnlAttributionPctOfTotalByBucket, which names the buckets, their amounts and shares; optional explain and residualWithinTolerance props take pnlAttributionExplainText and pnlAttributionResidualWithinTolerance; without residualWithinTolerance no verdict is shown. Nothing is summed, differenced or converted. Accepts attribution, buckets, loading, error and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: use-attribute-pnl-many
items.title: useAttributePnlMany
items.description: Attributes the T0 to T1 P&L of priced instruments through the WASM worker.
items.docs: attribution.attributePnlMany with one Rust AttributionInputs (the two MarketContext texts canonicalized through the worker's market cache and spliced as market_t0 and market_t1, never parsed; every other field, including the dates, the AttributionMethod and the optional config and credit-factor settings, passed through as supplied) over the instrument envelopes in order, then per result attribution.pnlAttributionExplainText, pnlAttributionResidualWithinTolerance against the run's own tolerances and pnlAttributionPctOfTotalByBucket. Returns one {attribution, explain, residualWithinTolerance, buckets} per instrument for PnlAttributionReport. An omitted option stays unset so Rust applies its default; a failing instrument fails the call with the native error. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-default-waterfall-order
items.title: useDefaultWaterfallOrder
items.description: Reads Rust's default waterfall attribution factor order through the WASM worker.
items.docs: attribution.defaultWaterfallOrder: the canonical snake_case factor names a waterfall AttributionMethod applies in order ({waterfall: order}). Immutable within one worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.
